description: Official NVIDIA profile, matching eugr’s Bolt recipe: tested image digest 4428520b, checkpoint e0590ed2 and LiLiCorr 4c6a5613; eight streams, automatic context fit, FP8 KV and seven-token DFlash. Preserves instanttensor loading, Mamba shared-prefix checkpoints and NVIDIA reasoning/tool parsers. Memory is a conservative per-node estimate, not a local measurement. Publication does not establish physical Spark qualification. The managed profile caps GPU utilization at 0.7 to include separate-drafter overhead and the platform OS floor; this capacity adjustment has not been physically qualified.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt LiLiCorr vLLM single Spark (NVIDIA/eugr)
